desc:
# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/neuralcompression
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/neuralcompression

## File: facebookresearch_neuralcompression/hubconf.py

Prompts

```
['load a pretrained MS-ILLM neural image compression model at 0.14 bpp using msillm_quality_3', 'load a pretrained No-GAN HiFiC Mean-Scale Hyperprior model at 0.3 bpp using noganms_quality_4', 'load a pretrained MS-ILLM ultra-low bitrate model at 0.00218 bpp using msillm_quality_vlo1', 'load a pretrained VQ-VAE model for discriminator label map generation using msillm_vqvae_xcit_p8_ch64_cb1024_h8', 'load any MS-ILLM or No-GAN model without pretrained weights by passing pretrained=False']
```

Usage

```
{'load_msillm_model': 'load a pretrained MS-ILLM neural image compression model at 0.14 bpp using msillm_quality_3', 'load_noganms_model': 'load a pretrained No-GAN HiFiC Mean-Scale Hyperprior model at 0.3 bpp using noganms_quality_4', 'load_ultralow_bitrate_model': 'load a pretrained MS-ILLM ultra-low bitrate model at 0.00218 bpp using msillm_quality_vlo1', 'load_vqvae_model': 'load a pretrained VQ-VAE model for discriminator label map generation using msillm_vqvae_xcit_p8_ch64_cb1024_h8', 'load_model_without_pretrained': 'load any MS-ILLM or No-GAN model without pretrained weights by passing pretrained=False'}
```
name: facebookresearch_neuralcompression/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_neuralcompression/hubco.load_msillm_model: load a pretrained MS-ILLM neural image compression model at 0.14 bpp using msillm_quality_3
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/hubco.load_noganms_model: load a pretrained No-GAN HiFiC Mean-Scale Hyperprior model at 0.3 bpp using noganms_quality_4

facebookresearch_neuralcompression/hubco.load_vqvae_model: load a pretrained VQ-VAE model for discriminator label map generation using msillm_vqvae_xcit_p8_ch64_cb1024_h8
facebookresearch_neuralcompression/hubco.load_model_without_pretrained: load any MS-ILLM or No-GAN model without pretrained weights by passing pretrained=False
